description: This file defines the GatewayDiscovery class, which manages discovery and resolution of gateway endpoints using DNS-SD, mDNS, and unicast DNS queries. It uses Android systems services and DNS Java library for network operations and updates a reactive state flow with discovered gateways.

classes.name: GatewayDiscovery
classes.description: Manages network gateway discovery via DNS-SD/mDNS and unicast DNS, maintaining a list of endpoints and related state.

methods.name: startLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates mDNS/DNS-SD service discovery.

methods.name: stopLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Stops mDNS/DNS-SD discovery process.

methods.name: startUnicastDiscovery
methods.description: Starts background task to periodically perform unicast DNS discovery.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves DNS service info into GatewayEndpoint instances.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Updates the reactive flow with the current list of gateways.

methods.name: buildStatusText
methods.description: Constructs a user-friendly status message based on discovery results.

methods.name: stableId
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for a service based on its name and domain.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Normalizes service names by trimming and collapsing whitespace.

methods.name: txt
methods.description: Extracts a text attribute from NsdServiceInfo.

methods.name: txtInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer attribute from NsdServiceInfo.

methods.name: txtBool
methods.description: Extracts a boolean attribute from NsdServiceInfo.

methods.name: refreshUnicast
methods.description: Performs a unicast DNS PTR/SRV/TXT query sequence to discover gateways.

methods.name: decodeInstanceName
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the instance name from a FQDN.

methods.name: stripTrailingDot
methods.description: Removes trailing dot from domain names.

methods.name: lookupUnicastMessage
methods.description: Performs DNS query for the given name and type, with fallback to direct resolver if needed.

methods.name: queryViaSystemDns
methods.description: Performs a DNS query over the system's DNS network.

methods.name: records
methods.description: Retrieves the specified section's resource records from a DNS message.

methods.name: keyName
methods.description: Normalizes FQDNs into lowercase key strings.

methods.name: recordsByName
methods.description: Groups DNS records by their normalized name.

methods.name: recordByName
methods.description: Fetches the first record of specified type for a given name from a DNS message.

methods.name: resolveHostFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts hostname/IP address from DNS message records for a given hostname.

methods.name: preferredDnsNetwork
methods.description: Selects the preferred network interface, prioritizing VPN if available.

methods.name: createDirectResolver
methods.description: Creates a DNS resolver targeting specific DNS servers on the active or VPN network.

methods.name: rawQuery
methods.description: Performs a DNS query over a specified network, returning raw answer bytes.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Extracts a string value for a key from TXT DNS records.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Extracts an int value for a key from TXT DNS records.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
methods.description: Interprets TXT record data as boolean for a given key.

methods.name: decodeDnsTxtString
methods.description: Decodes TXT strings as UTF-8, handling DNS-specific encodings.

methods.name: resolveHostUnicast
methods.description: Performs unicast DNS A/AAAA query to resolve hostname to IP address.
